titulo: Judo 2026 World Championships: Koga and Yusifov Strike Gold on Opening Day in Baku
cuerpo: Wakana Koga claimed her first world title at -48kg, defeating Assunta Scutto in the final. At -60kg, home favourite Ahmad Yusifov came from behind to beat Sherzod Davlatov, sending the Baku crowd into celebration on an unforgettable opening day.
